MOA: organic nitrates → NO → activates guanylate cyclase enzyme (form cGMP) → dephosphorylate myosin light chain (smooth musc) → relax-vasodilate
↑room in vessel for O2 to pass → rapid ↓♡O2 demand → rapid ↓Sx
▪︎AD: add NTG if BP still ↑ despite HR control
▪︎HTN emergency w AMI: NTG = DOC (↓preload & afterload → ↓myocard O2 consumption · ↑coronary perfusion) - w pulm edema: nitrates = mainstay
▪︎hypertensive acute HF/severe pulm edema: SL NTG while IV NTG titrated (high doses may be needed) - often followed by loop diuretic - ⍉inducing hypotension
▪︎ACS: NTG relieves ongoing CP · ↓BP - ⍉in RV infarct (preload dep → hypotension)
Contraindications: phosphodiesterase type 5 inhibitor (ED meds) → hypotension
Education: Tolerance develops rapidly → need nitrate-free interval daily (prn ⍉ as effective)
